declaring_sources.plan_vocabulary: schemas/validation-plan.schema.json and schemas/validation-cascade-plan.schema.json (plan, cascade and stage field sets, stage classes and failure actions, read by path)
declaring_sources.prediction_vocabulary: schemas/prediction-gene.schema.json and schemas/falsifier-gene.schema.json (prediction directions, falsifier trigger types and severities, read by path)

baseline_perturbation_metrics_fixed_befo.mechanism: the preregistration seals the plan's baseline, perturbation actions and metric surface before any result exists: the sealed plan re-derives its observables and single falsification_rule from the prediction register rather than accepting them beside it, SEALED_PLAN_FIELDS freezes exactly the plan surface a result would have to move while title and objective stay outside the seal, the receipt re-derives its own hash over its published fields and binds the exact target manifest and canonical vocabulary it screened, and the same arguments seal to byte-identical canonical JSON with no clock or random draw

identifiability_assessed.mechanism: a plan carrying no identifiability warning is refused IDENTIFIABILITY_UNASSESSED, a stochastic target sealed without a fixed seed is refused SEED_UNFIXED and a malformed environment digest ENVIRONMENT_DIGEST_MALFORMED, so a plan cannot preregister until its identifiability, seed and environment are pinned

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: bounded implementation agent; reviewer: the sealing agent, a distinct actor; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
